evidence.quote: Gail inspects a fossil with a clear spiral shape. One picture card shows the same shape, but she leaves it beside the exhibit until the curator checks it.

evidence.quote: Two picture cards share the same color, but one shows the outline of a foot and the other a bone. Gail compares shapes rather than colors alone.
